result.instructions: Tools for When I Work, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes When I Work data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run wheniwork_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wheniwork_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wheniwork_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. wheniwork_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wheniwork_get_account
tools.title: Get the account
tools.description: Fetch the When I Work account (workplace) the token acts on — company name, plan and settings; for a parent account also its child accounts. A cheap way to confirm the credentials work. When I Work: GET /2/account.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the employees, supervisors, managers and admins in the account, optionally limited to some schedules or searched by name/email. Role codes: 1 admin, 2 manager, 3 employee, 5 supervisor. When I Work: GET /2/users.

search.description: Search first name, last name or email.

show_pending.description: Include users who have not accepted their invite (default true).

tools.name: wheniwork_get_user
tools.title: Get one user
tools.description: Fetch one user by id — name, email, role, positions, schedules, wage. When I Work: GET /2/users/{id}.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_locations
tools.title: List schedules (locations)
tools.description: List the schedules in the account. The API calls a schedule a "location"; its id is the location_id every shift belongs to. When I Work: GET /2/locations.

only_unconfirmed.description: Only schedules whose address is unconfirmed.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_positions
tools.title: List positions
tools.description: List the positions (job roles such as Cashier or Dishwasher) in the account. When I Work: GET /2/positions.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List scheduled shifts in a time window — who works when, where and in which position — optionally including open shifts and unpublished drafts. Answers "who is on on Friday?" and "what open shifts are left?". When I Work: GET /2/shifts.

start.description: Start of the window. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

end.description: End of the window. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

unpublished.description: Include unpublished (draft) shifts — supervisor or above.

include_open.description: Include open (unassigned) shifts from the user's schedules.

include_allopen.description: Include open shifts across all schedules — manager or admin.

include_swaps.description: Include swap requests attached to the shifts.

deleted.description: Also return deleted_ids: shifts deleted in the window.

include_repeating_shifts_to.description: Also expand repeating shift series up to this date. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

tools.name: wheniwork_get_shift
tools.title: Get one shift
tools.description: Fetch one shift by id, including its breaks and publish state. When I Work: GET /2/shifts/{id}.

include_repeating_shifts_to.description: Also expand the shift's repeating series up to this date. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

tools.name: wheniwork_list_eligible_users_for_shift
tools.title: List users eligible for an open shift
tools.description: Find who could take an open shift — either an existing shift (shift_id) or a hypothetical one (start, end, position_id and location_id all required). When I Work: GET /2/shifts/eligible.

start.description: Start of the potential shift (required without shift_id). Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

end.description: End of the potential shift (required without shift_id). Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

position_id.description: Position of the potential shift (required without shift_id).

location_id.description: Schedule of the potential shift (required without shift_id).

is_shared.description: Whether it is a shared open shift.

include_objects.description: Include the users' schedules and positions in the output.

annotations.title: List users eligible for an open shift

tools.name: wheniwork_list_times
tools.title: List clocked times (timesheets)
tools.description: List clocked time entries — actual hours worked, clock-in/out times, length and approval state. Use only_open to see who is clocked in right now. When I Work: GET /2/times.

start.description: Start of the window. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

end.description: End of the window. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

only_open.description: Only times with no end yet (people currently clocked in).

updated_at.description: Only times updated since this timestamp. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

tools.name: wheniwork_list_time_off_requests
tools.title: List time-off requests
tools.description: List time-off requests in a date range, with the requesting users. Status: 0 pending, 1 canceled, 2 accepted, 3 expired, 4 denied. When I Work: GET /2/requests.

sortby.description: 'created' sorts newest first; anything else sorts by status then last update.

include_deleted_users.description: Include requests made by deleted users.

since_id.description: Only requests created after this request id.

max_id.description: Only requests created before this request id.

page.description: Page of results to load (the response says whether there are `more`).

tools.name: wheniwork_get_time_off_request
tools.title: Get one time-off request
tools.description: Fetch one time-off request by id, with its message thread and users. When I Work: GET /2/requests/{request_id}.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_time_off_types
tools.title: List time-off types
tools.description: List the time-off types (e.g. Personal, Sick, Holiday) and whether each allows paid time. Their ids are the type_id for a new request. When I Work: GET /2/requesttypes.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_shift_swaps
tools.title: List shift swaps and drops
tools.description: List shift requests: swaps, drops and alerts, with the shifts and users involved. Status: 0 pending, 1 approved, 2 declined, 3 completed, 4 canceled, 5 expired. Type: 1 swap, 2 drop, 3 alert. start and end must be given together. When I Work: GET /2/swaps.

start.description: Start of the shift window (give with end). Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

end.description: End of the shift window (give with start). Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

page.description: Page of results to load (the response says whether there are `more`).

tools.name: wheniwork_list_availability
tools.title: List availability
tools.description: List availability events — when people said they can or cannot work, including recurring patterns that fall in the window. Defaults to the caller, from now to two weeks out. When I Work: GET /2/availabilityevents.

start.description: Start of the window (default now). Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

end.description: End of the window (default two weeks from now). Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

include_all.description: Everyone's availability, not just one user's — managers only.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_annotations
tools.title: List schedule annotations
tools.description: List schedule annotations — announcements, business-closed days and blackout dates when time off is not allowed. Defaults to today through one year out. When I Work: GET /2/annotations.

start_date.description: Start of the range (default the start of today). Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

end_date.description: End of the range (default one year after start). Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

no_time_off.description: Only annotations that block time off.

tools.name: wheniwork_create_shift
tools.title: Create a shift
tools.description: Create one shift on a schedule — assigned to a user, or open (user_id 0). Created as a draft unless published is true. Undo by editing it or unpublishing. When I Work: POST /2/shifts.

location_id.description: The schedule (location) the shift belongs to id.

start_time.description: Shift start, date-time with offset, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00.

user_id.description: The user to assign. 0 (or omitted on create) makes it an open shift.

break_time.description: Unpaid break length in hours, e.g. 0.5.

notes.description: Shift notes shown to the employee.

is_shared.description: For an open shift: a shared open shift.

tools.name: wheniwork_update_shift
tools.title: Update a shift
tools.description: Change a shift — reassign it, move it, change position or notes. When I Work requires start_time, end_time and location_id on every update, so fetch the shift first and pass them back. This tool never sends a breaks array; When I Work documents that breaks omitted from an update's breaks list are removed, so re-check the shift's breaks afterwards. When I Work: PUT /2/shifts/{id}.

start_time.description: Shift start (required by the API even if unchanged).

end_time.description: Shift end (required by the API even if unchanged).

user_id.description: The user to assign. 0 (or omitted on create) makes it an open shift.

break_time.description: Unpaid break length in hours, e.g. 0.5.

notes.description: Shift notes shown to the employee.

is_shared.description: For an open shift: a shared open shift.

tools.name: wheniwork_publish_shifts
tools.title: Publish shifts
tools.description: Publish draft shifts so employees can see them. Publishing does not itself send notifications. Undo with wheniwork_unpublish_shifts. When I Work: POST /2/shifts/publish.

tools.name: wheniwork_unpublish_shifts
tools.title: Unpublish shifts
tools.description: Return published shifts to draft, hiding them from employees. Undo with wheniwork_publish_shifts. When I Work: POST /2/shifts/unpublish.

tools.name: wheniwork_create_time_off_request
tools.title: Create a time-off request
tools.description: Create a time-off request for a user (default the calling user). It starts pending; cancel it with wheniwork_update_time_off_request (status 1). Get type ids from wheniwork_list_time_off_types. When I Work: POST /2/requests.

start_time.description: Start of the time off, full date-time.

end_time.description: End of the time off, full date-time.

user_id.description: Who is taking time off (default the calling user).

paid.description: Whether it is paid time off.

hours.description: Hours of paid time off to use.

tools.name: wheniwork_update_time_off_request
tools.title: Approve, deny or change a time-off request
tools.description: Change a time-off request: set its status (0 pending, 1 canceled, 2 accepted/approved, 3 expired, 4 denied) and/or its dates or hours. Reversible — set the status back. start_time and end_time must be given together. When I Work: PUT /2/requests/{request_id}.

start_time.description: New start, full date-time (give with end_time).

end_time.description: New end, full date-time (give with start_time).

hours.description: Hours of paid time off to use.

annotations.title: Approve, deny or change a time-off request
